_comment: Report <-> app section contract. The Markdown report (birding/report.py) is
the source of truth for what each section is called, what order sections
appear in, and which sections carry a rendered map. The app mirrors that
content; only navigation differs (a Contents menu instead of one long page).
Kept as a fixture so BOTH repos can enforce it:
- birding-app/tests/dom.test.js       asserts the app matches this file.
so renaming a report section without updating the app fails CI.
'report' is a PREFIX of the heading report.py emits (several headings have
dynamic tails, e.g. county names or a year); '*' stands for an f-string slot.
'map' is the app's map container id, non-null only where the report embeds
reportSectionsAppOmits is a map of heading prefix -> WHY the app omits it.
It used to be a bare list, which made it an unaudited escape hatch: adding
a heading to it silently dropped that section from the app forever and the
TOC test still went green. Every entry now needs a reason, and PARITY.md
must carry a matching row - both repos assert it.

menu.label: 🧭 Where to go next
menu.why: the answer, not a source — every chase lane merged into one ranked list; mapless on purpose because each row already links its own hotspot and a 12-pin static map would repeat the sections it draws from

menu.label: 🔴 Happening now
menu.why: the only section whose contents expire in hours, so it leads the report; deliberately mapless — it is normally 0-3 rows with direct hotspot links, and another static-map generator works against the repo-size brake

menu.label: 🌤 Conditions for chasing
menu.why: heading is rendered by weather.py, not report.py

menu.label: 🏆 eBird Rankings & Top 100
menu.why: your standing plus the full Top 100 board you're ranked on — one section, one region; the board is collapsed in the report because each committed day is a dated snapshot eBird cannot re-serve

menu.label: 🔭 Latest ticks on the leaderboard
menu.why: the only sections with an expiry date are the rarity ones; this is the biggest section in the report and sat above them

menu.label: 👥 Birder convoys
menu.why: the report draws one map PER convoy, so the app builds per-convoy containers dynamically rather than one static id

menu.label: 📋 All unseen reports
menu.why: every unseen report collapsed to one row per species-per-place at 250 m, nearest first; mapless because it is a full dump and each row links its own hotspot

menu.label: 🥚 Easy misses
menu.why: common birds you should already have - the highest hit-rate chase list in the report

menu.label: ⚙️ Settings
menu.why: app-only: API key / home / report picker

reportSectionsAppOmits.## Contents: navigation furniture; the app has its own Contents menu
reportSectionsAppOmits.## Reports: index of published Markdown files - meaningless on device
reportSectionsAppOmits.## Run this on another computer: setup instructions for the pipeline repo
reportSectionsAppOmits.## 🔍 Watchlist: "needs verification" is a report-only concept - the app has no NV list
reportSectionsAppOmits.## 🏅 Your state rankings: rarity-tracker-only cross-region table; the app scopes to one region by design - switch regions in the nav instead
reportSectionsAppOmits.## 🗺️ * unseen — closest first: BACKLOG (review item 3): overlaps "Closest spots with unseen birds" and "All unseen reports"; merging the four unseen views is a product decision
reportSectionsAppOmits.## 🔬 iNaturalist unseen: BACKLOG: beta section reading a non-eBird source (iNaturalist), which the app has no client for
reportSectionsAppOmits.## 📅 Year-to-date ABA rarities: BACKLOG: rarity-tracker-only archive of the whole year; the app shows the live ABA alert instead
